opening.quote: Good morning, Tidewell my name is Lotte, how can I help ya?
opening.comment: The greeting gives the agent's name and the company name, so this criterion is met.

verification.quote: Can I have your full name and the order member or your postcode?
verification.comment: The agent asked for the full name and order number or postcode before sharing order data, which meets the requirement, though the caller's answer was given as a postcode-like string with a typo, so confirming it more clearly would help.

understanding.quote: Thank you, Priya. eye can yeah see an order for a kettle at €24.50 placed 6 working days ago.
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue of a missing kettle and did not re-ask for details already given, though the caller said the tracking stopped since Friday, which the agent did not acknowledge.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Since it's been 6 days I'll send you a placement kettle today, and you'll have it tomorrow.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The policy says a lost parcel investigation only opens after 10 working days, and a replacement for a non-arrived item is not promised after 6 days; the agent also promised next-day delivery when standard delivery is 2 to 4 working days.

process_compliance.quote: Since it's been 6 days I'll send you a placement kettle today, and you'll have it tomorrow.
process_compliance.comment: The agent did not ask for permission before any hold (none occurred), but the agent did not follow the lost-parcel process or confirm the order status before promising a replacement, and no email or photo step was taken for a damaged or wrong item since none applied.

communication.quote: Ah, okay. Since it's been 6 days I'll send you a placement kettle today, and you'll have it tomorrow.
communication.comment: The agent was polite at the start, but the caller's frustration about the parcel was acknowledged only once and the closing was abrupt, so communication is only partly met; the caller did not clearly express upset, so this is a yes on politeness.

closing.comment: The agent did not confirm the next steps clearly or ask if there was anything else before ending the call, so the closing is incomplete.
